label: Stack-frame checks
description: The first gg plugin (goal/G22.3): it governs its private goal of stack-frame items. Its goal and its rerun item, whose file list is the stack-frame suite oneDoorStacks.js alone, always stay open; its dialog takes a gate and an endpoint, adds the door to its list and makes a goal/G22.2-type item from them.
runs: Since goal/G22.3's 'RUN the show' (Andy, 2026-10-13): the Stacks tab lists the doors, each opening one dialog to edit it (stackFrameChecks.update, clearing its last verdict), remove it (stackFrameChecks.remove), and run it alone (stackFrameChecks.run). Every run is deskVerify's (Andy, 2026-10-13: 'every run here should report to deskVerify.'): run asks this node's deskVerify door.run and answers at once; deskVerify queues it with its other checks, keeps its row, records and verdict, shows its output in the Verifier tab's console, and its Stop ends it; runState and each door's last verdict are read from deskVerify's door.state. The plugin keeps only when each door last changed, in changed.json under the desk's --state, in plugins/stackFrameChecks/, never in git.
commits: After make, update or remove writes the list, the plugin commits that one file in the repo it lives in, 'plugin/stackFrameChecks: <what changed>', and pushes it with pushOrigin; with other changes staged it does not commit, and a failed push leaves the commit local; the reply's commit line says which (goal/G22.3, Andy, 2026-10-13: 'the commit function has to be there.').
list: stackFrameList.json beside this file, read by the stack-frame test: an array of doors {id, gate, endpoint, paths, suites, item}. id: the door's own, stable, d<n>. gate: spirit/run/<file>.js::<function>, one function (a whole module as the gate is cheating). endpoint: spirit/run/<file>.js, the whole module (every exported function and what an exported factory returns), or node:http+https+fetch for Node's own requests, with paths, the request paths it counts (the relay's: /api/relay/). suites: the suites that drive it, measured by an agent, empty until then (an empty run is its red). item: the desk item that asked for it. (goal/G22.3, Andy's decision 2026-10-13)
